description: App-only import adapter: forwards input.rows and optional source information to catalog preparation for the selected salonId, then saves a preview. Does not import services or staff. In conversation, use beautyos_catalog_import_prepare with its specific schema; this adapter serves the form with nested input. Show all effects and apply with beautyos_apply_change only after explicit owner confirmation.
name: beautyos_prepare_catalog_import
title: UI: catalog import preview
